<?php
function h($n,$m,$f,$l) { $GLOBALS["source"]["node"]["k"]=7; unset($GLOBALS["source"]); echo "H;"; return true; }
function make() { echo "P;"; return $GLOBALS["source"]; }
function &take(&$value) { echo "F:",$value["node"]["k"],";"; $value["node"]["k"] += 10; return $value; }
$seed=5; $source=["node"=>["k"=>$seed]]; $copy=$source; $r=900; set_error_handler('h');
$r =& take(value:make()); $r["node"]["k"] += 100;
echo "R:",$r["node"]["k"],":",$copy["node"]["k"],":",(int)!isset($source),";";
